W hen the TDR drill holes are drilled into the 14N FOG area an underground spotter should be
used to monitor the occurrence of any water ingress or potential instability in the excavation
back. This would need to be undertaken at a safe distance from the break-through point, from
a point deemed safe by mine personnel, having reviewed the drill hole orientation and
potential hole- through point, following measurements made where the drill hole is adequately
cased and set into the bedrock.
